title: Marcos attends APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting in China
summary: SHENZHEN, China -- President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr. on Thursday morning joined world leaders during the 33rd Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Economic Leaders" Meeting in Shenzhen,…

blocks.text: President Bongbong Marcos at the APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting in Shenzhen, China. Marcos is also set to have meetings with the leaders of Vietnam, Mexico, Chile, Peru, and Papua New Guinea today. | via Ivan Mayrina, Giselle Ombay/GMA News

SHENZHEN, China — President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr. on Thursday morning joined world leaders during the 33rd Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Economic Leaders’ Meeting in Shenzhen, China.
Marcos was seen seated between Russian President Vladimir Putin and Peruvian President Keiko Fujimori.
Also present in this year’s APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting (AELM) were Chinese President Xi Jinping and US President Donald Trump, among others.
The AELM brought together economic leaders from the 21 APEC member economies to discuss matters on trade and investment, business facilitations, and economic and technical cooperation.

Marcos and his entire delegation arrived in China on Wednesday afternoon.
Aside from the AELM, the Philippine president is expected to have pull-aside meetings with Vietnamese President Tô Lâm and Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum this morning.

In the afternoon, Marcos is expected to engage in bilateral meetings with Chilean President Jose Antonio Kast, Peruvian President Keiko Fujimori, and Papua New Guinea Prime Minister James Marape. — RSJ/GMA News
